title: Deposit adhesion and peel screen
purpose: Resolve the gating unknown cell_architecture.py flagged and declined to compute: whether electrodeposited iron peels from a drum cathode, and therefore whether the continuous-foil architecture branch survives.

model_scope.provenance: Screening model. No wet-lab iron adhesion data exists in this repository. Surface energies are clean-surface literature values; interface energies and plastic amplification factors are engineering estimates by bonding class, transferred from copper-foil and electroforming practice.
computes: Residual stress decomposed into intrinsic, hydrogen and thermal
Steady-state strain-energy release rate G(σ, h)
Interfacial toughness from work of adhesion × plastic × roughness
Hydrogen knockdown of interfacial toughness (Rice-Wang form)
Steady-state peel force per width at arbitrary peel angle
Web stress and the tear-before-peel criterion
Substrate ranking and the drum-and-strip branch verdict
Stoney inversion of measured coupon curvature
does_not_compute: Mode-mixity of the interfacial crack (assumed steady-state peel)
Rate/temperature dependence of the plastic dissipation term
Adhesion evolution over drum service life or passivation drift
Localised adhesion failure: pinholes, edge build-up, nodules
Whether the peeled foil is metallurgically acceptable
calibration_required: 90° peel toughness of iron on the actual drum surface
Residual stress by coupon curvature (Stoney) in the actual bath
Hoffman relaxation distance Δ for this deposit
model_scope.key_uncertainty: plastic_amplification spans roughly an order of magnitude in the peel literature and is the single parameter most likely to flip the verdict. amplification_robustness() reports whether it does.

foil_route_verdict.interpretation: The foil branch is neither confirmed nor killed by the screen: the reference surface returns 'clean_peel' and viable alternatives are [stainless_316_passive, chromium_plated]. The verdict moves within the plausible plastic-amplification range, so the peel coupon is the cheapest way to resolve it and must precede any drum spend.

coupon_test_protocol.title: Iron-on-substrate adhesion coupon set (Day-1 add-on)
coupon_test_protocol.runs_alongside: The Phase-II Hull cell order in docs/FIRST_LAB_DAY.md — same bath, same rectifier, same session.

measurements.measurement: 90° peel test, ASTM B571 / D6862 geometry
measurements.instrument: Load cell on a motorised stage, 10 mm strip
measurements.yields: Peel force per width → interfacial toughness Γ
measurements.replaces_in_model: plastic_amplification — the least-constrained parameter in interfacial_toughness()

measurements.measurement: Coupon curvature before and after deposition
measurements.instrument: Stylus profilometer or optical flat on 100 µm shim stock
measurements.replaces_in_model: HOFFMAN_DELTA_M and the whole forward residual-stress estimate

measurements.measurement: Deposit thickness by mass and by cross-section
measurements.yields: h for G = (1−ν)σ²h/E, and a Faradaic cross-check

measurements.replaces_in_model: critical_thickness_um() — a direct, single-number test of the whole energy balance

decision_rules.kills_foil_branch: Iron on passive TiO₂ requires >200 N/m to peel, or the peeled strip fractures at any thickness that plates in a reasonable drum residence time.
decision_rules.confirms_foil_branch: A reproducible peel force between 5 and 200 N/m with an intact strip and ≥2× margin to web yielding.
decision_rules.redirects_to_flake: Deposits self-release below the target foil thickness — adopt the flake/powder harvest path and delete the winder.

coupon_test_protocol.why_now: It is the cheapest experiment that can delete an entire architecture branch. Every drum, winder and tension-control decision downstream is contingent on its result, and the screen's verdict is not robust to the one parameter it cannot estimate from first principles.

findings: Reference drum surface (passive TiO₂) at 96 MPa residual stress returns 'clean_peel': peel force 5.0 N/m against a 5–200 N/m machine window.
Conductive surfaces inside the peel window: ti_passive_tio2, stainless_316_passive, chromium_plated.
Rejected as too strongly bonded to strip: copper_substrate, ti_bare_etched — including the deliberate metallic negative controls, which is the check that the screen discriminates at all.
Rejected on physics rather than omission: ptfe_release_coating release beautifully and cannot pass current, so they cannot be a cathode.
Verdict for the drum-and-strip branch: proceed_with_coupon_test (robust to the plastic-amplification uncertainty: False).

Propagating a real operating point (100 mA/cm², 85% FE, 15 min) through the existing models gives 28 µm of deposit carrying 241 ppm diffusible hydrogen, and the deposit then returns 'spontaneous_delamination' — hydrogen, not the substrate, dominates the stress state at 373 MPa.
Critical self-delamination thickness on the reference surface is 187 µm at the screen's baseline conditions, which bounds foil thickness from above independently of any winder capability.
The screen does not settle the question and is not meant to: it converts an unpriced unknown into a $1,750, 3-day coupon test with explicit kill and confirm rules (coupon_test_protocol).
